name: Letter stagger
what: Text that comes in one letter (or one word) at a time - left to right, from the middle out or in a random order - each rising out of a blur, dropping in with a bounce, zooming down out of focus or flipping up in 3D; it pushes in slowly while it holds, and at the end the letters leave the same way. Accent words in an italic serif.
origin: MotionLab's own build of the letter and word staggers of GSAP SplitText (from the start, the centre or at random) - the user asked for text that appears word by word or similar (2026-10-31)
motion: from f0 the letters come in one every gap (1.2 f; words three times as far apart) in the order chosen: each rises 0.55 em out of a blur over 14 f (decelerating hard) - or drops from 0.7 em above with a small overshoot (16 f), zooms down from 1.9x out of focus (14 f, slow end) or flips up 100 degrees around its foot (15 f, a small overshoot); the text pushes in 3 % over the hold (gentle S-curve); at the end the letters leave in the same order, each the move's own way out, 9 f each (accelerating)

tracks.name: letters
tracks.what: the letters come in one after another

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: the letters leave one after another

min_frames: start + round(((len(text) * gap if by == 'letters' else (parts(text, ' ') + parts(text, '|') - 1) * gap * 3) + 20) * fps / 30)
min_why: every letter has to come in before it ends
